data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 失败后反思并蒸馏为低秩适配器，持久保存并按需路由到后续任务，构成反馈驱动的持久改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter.
scope_support.object_quote: We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates.
scope_support.persistence_quote: The agent then saves these adapters in a persistent library of lessons, automatically routing them to solve related problems later.
